headline: Arisinfra Solutions secures NCLT approval for first motion merger application
hook: First hurdle cleared in Arisinfra merger
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has approved its first motion application regarding a proposed amalgamation or merger. The company informed the stock exchange about this legal progression. This is an early procedural step in a multi-stage corporate restructuring process. Indian retail investors holding shares should note that the merger is still in early phases and requires further approvals before completion.
whats_next: Second motion application and final NCLT hearing
why_it_matters: Early procedural step with no immediate impact on share value
